I'll start by reading the docs and looking at the workspace.

Docs read. Now I'll write the script.

The script is at `/app/bin/hourly.py`, and I ran it on `/app/data` to produce `/app/out/hourly.json`.

- **Unit tests:** `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` ran 4 tests, all OK.
- **Approved-values check:** `python tools/check_hourly.py` reported that every hourly value matches the approved values. All six quantities matched in all 1131 approved hours.
- **Rules:** I wrote it from the rules in `/app/docs`, not from what the current files contain.
- **Ambiguous case:** If the wind vectors of an hour cancel out exactly, the docs don't say what to report. I output null for `wdir` there.

I also wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./data -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; ls data | head -50; ls data | wc -l; cat docs/overview.md

cd /app; cat tools/check_hourly.py | head -60; cat tests/test_hourly.py | head -50; cd data; head -20 dump-1024b5.log cx62_20270503_0438.log | cat -A | cut -c1-150 | head -60; grep -h '^#' *.log | sed 's/:.*//' | sort | uniq -c; grep -h '^# units' *.log | sort | uniq -c | head -30
cd /app; mkdir -p out; python3 bin/hourly.py data out/hourly.json; echo $?; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -15; python tools/check_hourly.py

cd /app; sed -i '/^                lg = ref = None$/d' bin/hourly.py; python3 bin/hourly.py data out/hourly.json && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -3; python tools/check_hourly.py | head -2; echo '{"status":"success","summary":"Wrote /app/bin/hourly.py implementing the documented rules (units, time zones, dedup by upload, drift correction, coverage, vector wind mean, rain increments) and generated /app/out/hourly.json; unit tests and check_hourly.py all pass."}' > STATUS.json
